q: How many four digit even numbers can be formed using the digits {2, 3, 5, 1, 7, 9} ?
e:
The given digits are 1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 9 
A number is even when its units digit is even. Of the given digits, two is the only even digit.
Units place is filled with only '2' and the remaining three places can be filled in ⁵P₃ ways.
Number of even numbers = ⁵P₃ = 60.

We know that, the number of straight lines that can be formed by the 11 points in which 6 points are collinear and no other set of three points, except those that can be selected out of these 6 points are collinear.

= ¹¹C₂ - ⁶C₂ - ⁵C₂ + 1 + 1
= 55 - 15 - 10 + 2 = 32

q: The number of arrangements that can be made with the letters of the word MEADOWS so that the vowels occupy the even places?
e:
The word MEADOWS has 7 letters of which 3 are vowels.
-V-V-V-
As the vowels have to occupy even places, they can be arranged in the 3 even places in 3! i.e., 6 ways. While the consonants can be arranged among themselves in the remaining 4 places in 4! i.e., 24 ways. 
Hence the total ways are 24 * 6 = 144.

q: The sum of the ages of a father and son is 45 years. Five years ago, the product of their ages was four times the fathers age at that time. The present age of father and son?
e:
Let sons age = x years. Then fathers age = (45 - x)years. 
(x—5)(45—x—5) = 4(45- x - 5) hence (x—5) = 4 so x = 9 
Their ages are 36 years and 9 years.
